name: Equality

subjectOf.text: Equality is a natural byproduct of the blockchain-driven evolution of the crypto economy, because the trust enhancing consensus model, smart contracting in anonymous networks, and DAOs together allow a more equal society to evolve.
subjectOf.abstract: Equality is a natural byproduct of the blockchain-driven evolution of the crypto economy. Blockchain's trust enhancing consensus model, smart contracting in anonymous networks, and DAOs allow for the evolution of a more equal society.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3071378
scope_conditions: continued evolution of the crypto economy

subjectOf.text: Decentralism produces greater equality not through markets or governmental redistribution but through preserving diversity of content, diversity of data sources, and enhanced node connectivity.
subjectOf.abstract: decentralism creates higher levels of equality in society through the preservation of diversity of content, diversity of data sources, and enhanced node connectivity
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041
